verses.ar: وَكَانَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَشِبُّ فِي الْيَوْمِ شَبَابَ الصَّبِيِّ فِي الشَّهْرِ بِعِنَايَةٍ رَبَّانِيَّةْ ۞ فَقَامَ عَلٰى قَدَمَيْهِ فِي ثَلَاثٍ وَمَشَى فِي خَمْسٍ وَقَوِيَتْ فِي تِسْعٍ مِنَ الشُّهُورِ بِفَصِيحِ النُّطْقِ قُوَاهْ ۞ وَشَقَّ الْمَلَكَانِ صَدْرَهُ الشَّرِيفَ لَدَيْهَا وَأَخْرَجَا مِنْهُ عَلَقَةً دَمَوِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-kāna ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama yashibbu fī l-yawmi shabāba ṣ-ṣabiyyi fī sh-shahri bi-ʿināyatin rabbāniyyah, fa-qāma ʿalā qadamayhi fī thalāthin wa-mashā fī khamsin wa-qawiyat fī tisʿin mina sh-shuhūri bi-faṣīḥi n-nuṭqi quwāh, wa-shaqqa l-malakāni ṣadrahu sh-sharīfa ladayhā wa-akhrajā minhu ʿalaqatan damawiyyah.
verses.en: He, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, would grow in a single day as much as a child would grow in a month, through Divine Care. He stood upon his feet at three months, walked at five months, and by nine months his strength had developed such that he spoke with clear and eloquent speech. The two angels then opened his noble chest while he was with her and removed from it a clot of blood.

verses.ar: وَأَزَالَا مِنْهُ حَظَّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَبِالثَّلْجِ غَسَلَاهْ ۞ وَمَلَآهُ حِكْمَةً وَمَعَانِيَ إِيمَانِيَّةْ ۞ ثُمَّ خَاطَاهُ وَبِخَاتَمِ النُّبُوَّةِ خَتَمَاهْ ۞ وَوَزَنَاهُ فَرَجَحَ بِأَلْفٍ مِنْ أُمَّتِهِ الْخَيْرِيَّةْ ۞ وَنَشَأَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلٰى أَكْمَلِ الْأَوْصَافِ مِنْ حَالِ صِبَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-azālā minhu ḥaẓẓa sh-shayṭāni wa-bi-th-thalji ghasalāh, wa-mala'āhu ḥikmatan wa-maʿāniya īmāniyyah, thumma khāṭāhu wa-bi-khātami n-nubuwwati khatamāh, wa-wazanāhu fa-rajaḥa bi-alfin min ummatihi l-khayriyyah, wa-nasha'a ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama ʿalā akmali l-awṣāfi min ḥāli ṣibāh.
verses.en: They removed from him all that by which Satan could claim a share, washed him with snow, filled him with wisdom and the meanings of faith, then stitched him and sealed him with the Seal of Prophethood. They weighed him, and he outweighed a thousand members of his blessed community. He, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, grew up possessing the most perfect qualities from the days of his childhood.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ رَدَّتْهُ إِلَى أُمِّهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهِيَ بِهِ غَيْرُ سَخِيَّةْ ۞ حَذَرًا مِنْ أَنْ يُصَابَ بِمُصَابِ حَادِثٍ تَخْشَاهْ ۞ وَوَفَدَتْ عَلَيْهِ حَلِيمَةُ فِي أَيَّامِ خَدِيجَةَ السَّيِّدَةِ الْمَرْضِيَّةْ ۞ فَحَبَاهَا مِنْ حِبَائِهِ الْوَافِرِ بِحَيَاهْ ۞ وَقَدِمَتْ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهَا وَأَخَذَتْهُ الْأَرْيَحِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Thumma raddat-hu ilā ummihi ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama wa-hiya bihi ghayru sakhiyyah, ḥadharan min an yuṣāba bi-muṣābi ḥādithin takhshāh, wa-wafadat ʿalayhi Ḥalīmatu fī ayyāmi Khadījata s-sayyidati l-marḍiyyah, fa-ḥabāhā min ḥibā'ihi l-wāfiri bi-ḥayāh, wa-qadimat ʿalayhi yawma Ḥunaynin fa-qāma ilayhā wa-akhadhat-hu l-aryaḥiyyah.
verses.en: Then Halimah returned him, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, to his mother, though she was unwilling to part with him, fearing that some misfortune she dreaded might befall him. Halimah later came to visit him during the lifetime of the esteemed Lady Khadijah, and he showered her with gifts from his abundant generosity. She also came to him on the day of Hunayn, and he rose to receive her, moved by warm-hearted generosity.

verses.ar: وَبَسَطَ لَهَا مِنْ رِدَائِهِ الشَّرِيفِ بِسَاطَ بِرِّهِ وَنَدَاهْ ۞ وَالصَّحِيحُ أَنَّهَا أَسْلَمَتْ مَعَ زَوْجِهَا وَالْبَنِينَ وَالذُّرِّيَّةْ ۞ وَقَدْ عَدَّهُمْ فِي الصَّحَابَةِ جَمْعٌ مِنْ ثِقَاتِ الرُّوَاةْ
verses.tr: Wa-basaṭa lahā min ridā'ihi sh-sharīfi bisāṭa birrihi wa-nadāh, wa-ṣ-ṣaḥīḥu annahā aslamat maʿa zawjihā wa-l-banīna wa-dh-dhurriyyah, wa-qad ʿaddahum fī ṣ-ṣaḥābati jamʿun min thiqāti r-ruwāh.
verses.en: And he spread out his noble cloak for her as a carpet of his kindness and generosity. The soundest view is that she embraced Islam along with her husband, her children, and her descendants, and a number of trustworthy narrators counted them among the Companions.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
